summary: A resident reviewing a new library sees a place for patrons but wants to know where their belongings will go.
realLife: At the March 2024 trustees' meeting, Yvette Jarreau requested more storage and a place for patrons' possessions while the South End branch was being planned.
inGame: needs: public request and current room plan.

turns.pulledBy: The designer assigns storage near a staffed area.
turns.what: The resident reviews its location at the next meeting.
turns.writesBack: The plan identifies where visitors can put belongings.

turns.pulledBy: The proposal supplies staff storage only.
turns.what: The trustee asks for the public request to be answered separately.
turns.writesBack: The comment log keeps the unresolved item.
